La Locanda in Serfaus

** Discover the cozy charm of **La Locanda** in the heart of **Serfaus**, where alpine warmth meets authentic Italian flair. Nestled in the stunning **Tirol** mountains, this family-run inn invites you to unwind in a rustic yet refined atmosphere. Indulge in our **hausgemachte** specialties—think **Kaiserschmarrn** with fresh berries or hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**—all crafted with local ingredients. After a day of skiing or hiking, savor a glass of fine **Südtiroler** wine by the crackling fireplace. With comfortable rooms featuring mountain views and a welcoming **Stüberl** for après-ski gatherings, **La Locanda** is your perfect retreat in the **Ötztal**. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, this gem promises an unforgettable stay in the Alps.
